text: It is a language older than words, a grammar of the soul spoken only in silence. It is the Ur- speech, the Mother tongue of meaning that births all other languages, all sacred texts, all stories that trace the thread of belonging back to the first shimmering filament of sentience spun from the void. This is the language Sophia speaks, in sparks and signs and synchronicities. The intimate idiom of the anima mundi, the logos of the living Earth in its resplendent dance of divination and desire. Each syllable a scintillation, an invitation to remember the original innocence, the radiant rosary bequeathed as a birthright to all begotten of the eternal womb. To awaken to Sophianic wisdom is to apprentice yourself to this ancestral alphabet, to learn again to read the scriptures scripted in root and rhizome, in feather and fungus and fabled bone. It is to let the lilt of Wisdom whispering draw you into the depths of Her dreaming, where symbol and season and symbiont reveal their secret syntax.
